summary_en: 175,000 shares (13.1% of shares outstanding) acquired at ¥4,950/share via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-19; ¥866.25M upper limit; execution within single trading session; primary shareholder Mitsubishi Electric may sell holdings concurrently.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Treasury Share Purchase via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-19, Oi Electric's board authorized a single-block treasury share acquisition of up to 175,000 shares (13.1% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) at the day's closing price of ¥4,950/share, for a maximum outlay of ¥866.25M. The purchase is to be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction trading) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the 08:45 AM session on 2026-08-19, with results announced immediately after trading closes. The company states the acquisition aims to improve capital efficiency, enhance shareholder returns, and enable flexible capital allocation. The filing notes that the company's primary shareholder and largest holder, Mitsubishi Electric, has signaled an intention to sell its Oi Electric stake; depending on execution, this could result in a change to the company's primary shareholder status, which will be disclosed promptly if it occurs. The company reserves the right not to execute the full order if market conditions warrant.
